L69: ## The Hollows Haunted Trail at Brookdale Farms – Eureka, MO
L70: 
L71: Step into The Hollows, Brookdale Farms’ newest haunted attraction. This haunted walking trail near St. Louis takes you deep into cursed woods, foggy paths, and terrifying scenes pulled straight from Old West legends. The full trail takes about 40 minutes, depending on your pace—and every step could be your last.

L284: ## The Beginning – Curse of The Hollows
L285: 
L286: Darkness falls on the small town of Hollow Point. Ranchers, hunters, and townsfolk once thrived here—until the curse took root. Some say it began with the Vulture Witch, feathers black as night. Others say it was vengeance for blood spilled on sacred ground. Whatever the truth, souls now twist into shadows, and those who linger too long are never the same.
L287: 
L288: 【52†Image: The Hollows at Brookdale Farms in Eureka, MO - Haunted Trail Near St. Louis†static.wixstatic.com】
L289: ## The Saloon of the Damned
L290: 
L291: ## Once filled with music and laughter, the Hollow Point saloon never found peace. The piano plays itself, mirrors reflect faces that aren’t your own, and the Belle of the Hollows still smiles at strangers—though if she takes your hand, you’ll never leave.
L292: 
L293: 【53†Image: The Hollows at Brookdale Farms in Eureka, MO - Haunted Trail Near St. Louis†static.wixstatic.com】
L294: 
L295: ## The Gallows Grove – Hollow Marshal on Horseback
L296: ## The sheriff’s rope could not cleanse the curse. Thirteen souls swung beneath the crooked tree, but now the Hollow Marshal rides eternally on his skeletal steed. His noose swings, his eyes burn, and when you hear the creak of rope behind you—do not look back.
L297: 
L298: 【54†Image: The Hollows at Brookdale Farms in Eureka, MO - Haunted Trail Near St. Louis†static.wixstatic.com】
L299: 
L300: ## The Twisted Trailhead – The Vulture Witch
L301: ## What was once a safe road for ranchers now crawls with cursed roots and whispering trees. The Vulture Witch waits in the branches above. If you hear her voice, it’s already too late.
L302: 
L303: ## The Ghostly Fiddler
L304: 
L305: ## The fiddler of Hollow Point played at every gathering—until the skinwalkers came. Now his mournful tune drifts on the wind, luring travelers closer. Beware: when the music stops, the silence is worse than death.
L306: 
L307: ## The Cornfield Rider
L308: ## Beyond the corn rows rides the headless Rider of the Hollows. His axe gleams with lightning, his steed breathes smoke and fire, and the ground trembles at his charge. If his shadow crosses you, another neck will roll before dawn.
L309: 
L310: 【55†Image: The Hollows at Brookdale Farms in Eureka, MO - Haunted Trail Near St. Louis†static.wixstatic.com】
L311: 
L312: ## The Trapper’s Camp
L313: ## The old trapper knew these woods, but the skinwalkers flayed him like the hides he once tanned. His broken form begs for help beside the campfire, but step too close and you’ll be dragged into his fate.
L314: ## The Haunted Barn – Burned Rancher
L315: 
L316: This barn once sheltered cattle and grain, the pride of a rancher’s work. But fire swept through, leaving only ash. Now, the Burned Rancher walks these ruins. His skin smolders, his hat fused to his skull, his voice forever begging for water. The hay hides more than vermin — it hides the things he calls his own. If the flames don’t claim you…he will.
L317: 
L318: 【56†Image: The Hollows at Brookdale Farms in Eureka, MO - Haunted Trail Near St. Louis†static.wixstatic.com】
L319: ## Devil’s Ridge – The Finale
L320: 
L321: ## Here the curse is strongest. The ground splits open, shadows gather, and from the pit rises the Alpha Skinwalker—taller than any man, claws sharp as scythes, eyes glowing like embers. At Devil’s Ridge, you’ll discover the truth: The Hollows do not let you leave.

L327: ## The Hollows FAQs
L328: ### What is The Hollows Haunted Trail?
L329: 
L330: The Hollows Haunted Trail is an outdoor haunted walkthrough experience at Brookdale Farms near St. Louis, MO. Guests traverse fog-filled woods, corn-maze sections and themed scenes pulled from Old West legends, featuring live actors, strobe lights and immersive effects.
L331: 
L332: ### How long does the trail last?
L333: 
L334: The estimated duration to complete The Hollows is about 40 minutes, though actual time may vary depending on pace.
L335: ### How much are tickets and what is included?
L336: 
L337: General admission for the 2025 season is listed as $28 (including tax and service fees) for one person. There is also a “Bundle Pass (4 Guests)” available online for $100. Tickets include admission to The Hollows haunted walkthrough only. Prices are subject to change.
L338: ### Is this attraction suitable for children or all ages?
L339: 
L340: Yes — the attraction is open to “All-Ages.” However, anyone under 18 must be accompanied by an adult. Brookdale Farms asks that parents use their discretion with young children. Be aware: it’s a haunted trail with live actors, fog, strobe lights, and scary scenes.
L341: ### What type of scares and effects are present?
L342: 
L343: The trail features outdoor scare-elements including fog, strobe lights, live actors, and thematic scenes (woods, corn maze, etc.). This is a full immersive haunt experience—not a mild walk-through.
L344: ### Are there age, mobility or health restrictions I should know about?
L345: 
L346: While there is no explicit minimum age listed, because of the nature of the attraction (darkness, sudden scares, uneven terrain such as woods and a corn maze), guests with mobility issues, photosensitivity (from strobe lights), or who are easily startled should consider whether the experience is appropriate for them or their children. (Brookdale Farms asks parents to use their own discretion for younger children.)
L347: ### How do I purchase tickets and is it better to buy ahead?
L348: 
L349: Tickets can be purchased online. A 4-Guest bundle pass is available online only. Pre-purchase is recommended because the ticket sales end one hour before closing, and you must check in by that time. Arriving late may risk not being allowed to join the trail.
L350: ### What else is available on site (food, drink, other activities)?
L351: 
L352: On-site beverage purchases are available at the “Sippin’ Saloon”. Brookdale Farms also has other attractions and events on select nights at the same time as The Hollows that will require a separate ticket purchase.
L353: ### What should I wear?
L354: 
L355: Wear comfortable shoes and dress for outdoor terrain and weather (trail goes through woods and corn maze). Avoid wearing costumes that could get caught or restrict movement. Since fog, strobe lights and live actors are involved, consider comfort and safety (e.g., if sensitive to strobes or loud noises). Bring a light jacket if evenings are cool.
L356: ### Are refund or reschedule options available?
L357: 
L358: No refunds or transfers unless the attraction is closed due to weather.
